entries.summary: A mode changes two things at once: the instructions the model gets, and the tools that exist for that turn. It is the most consequential control in the composer, and it is one click. Nine modes exist. Four are in the composer strip; the rest belong to a surface or a workflow and
headings: Modes are a ceiling, not a grant

entries.summary: A tool is a function the model may call: read a file, run a command, search the web, write a Brain page, open a browser tab. Minnow ships 114 of them, of which 106 are exposed in this build — the rest belong to apps held behind the release gate. Tools are what make Minnow useful
